close_reason: Decision recorded: onSuccessUpdateEmail enforcement is spec-mandated (draft §3.1 MUST)
description: handle_mdn_send requires onSuccessUpdateEmail to be present and set keywords/$mdnsent: true for each send entry. This might look overly strict. The spec (draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §3.1, lines 350-352) says: 'the server MUST reject an MDN/send which does not result in setting the keyword $mdnsent. Thus the server MUST check that the onSuccessUpdateEmail property of the method is correctly set.' The enforcement is correct. Do not relax it.
title: onSuccessUpdateEmail enforcement verified correct against spec §3.1
